name: What design considerations are important for a casita?

mainEntity.name: What design considerations are important for a casita?

acceptedAnswer.text: Important design considerations for a casita include its size and layout, ensuring it complements the existing main home and meets local setback requirements. Think about its intended use: will it be a guest suite, a rental, or a workspace? This will inform decisions on plumbing for a kitchen/bathroom, natural light, privacy, and accessibility. Integrating it seamlessly with the existing landscape and utility connections is also key for functionality and aesthetic appeal.
acceptedAnswer.description: Key casita design factors include size, layout, intended use (e.g., guest suite, rental), and how it complements the main home. Consider plumbing, natural light, privacy, and utility integration.
